Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.network

Class RenderOverridePkt

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.network.RenderOverridePkt
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
public class RenderOverridePkt extends Object implements net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
Server to client: applies or resets one entry in the receiving client's user render override layer, as directed by the ss item command.
